IsAllowedInShops.maps_to: is_allowed_in_shops = False (amethyst_aubergine.py:13), read by the shop stocking path

IsAllowed.issue: AmethystAubergine.cs:20-23 refuses to spawn from the Act 3 treasure chest onward (RelicModel.IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest, RelicModel.cs:452-456: `runState.TotalFloor < 41` in single-player). The sim's Relic base class (sts2_rl/relics/base.py) declares no is_allowed member at all, and relic_pools.populate_relic_grab_bags shuffles the whole transcribed pool once at run init with no per-pull eligibility filter, so Amethyst Aubergine stays pullable for the entire run. REACHABILITY (LIVE): the relic is in the transcribed shared pool as Common (relic_pools.py:'RELIC.AMETHYST_AUBERGINE'), the sim tracks TotalFloor (run.py total_floor, already used by event gates), and runs reach floor 41. The observable is pool composition: a late grab-bag pull can hand out a relic the game would have filtered, which also shifts every subsequent pull. NOTE: the sim has no is_allowed concept for relics at all, so this is one instance of a base-class-wide omission, not an Aubergine-only slip. The pool-wide sweep has since run (py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-isallowed; findings in .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md): TWENTY ported relics override IsAllowed. SIXTEEN of them -- amethyst_aubergine, book_of_five_rings, bowler_hat, dragon_fruit, frozen_egg, girya, juzu_bracelet, lucky_fysh, meal_ticket, molten_egg, old_coin, planisphere, shovel, toxic_egg, white_beast_statue, white_star -- share this exact IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest gate and are all unmodelled, so the fix is one base-class member plus one filter in the pull path, not sixteen separate fixes. The other four are clean or deferred: massive_scroll (Players.Count > 1, never allowed in single-player, absent from the grab bag and already gated at Neow by is_allowed_at_neow=False), silver_crucible and winged_boots (Players.Count == 1, always allowed here), and lasting_candy (gated on the Ironclad's UnlockState, likely a waiver but left for its own batch).

TryModifyRewards.maps_to: no counterpart; Relic.modify_combat_rewards (relics/base.py:168) is the hook it would map to and the sim's port does not implement it
TryModifyRewards.issue: MECHANISM: AmethystAubergine.cs:25-45 appends a GoldReward(15) to the rewards of every combat room, skipping only non-combat rooms and the FINAL act's boss (`room.RoomType == Boss && CurrentActIndex >= Acts.Count - 1`). The sim registers the relic as a behaviourless stub whose docstring says the effect is 'out-of-combat only (the sim has no gold), so this is a no-op stub' -- and that premise is FALSE. The sim has gold (RunState.gold, run.py:325 gain_gold), has a combat rewards screen that rolls and grants it (rewards.py:462-464, 483-485), and runs `relic.modify_combat_rewards(run, rewards)` over the run's relics right after (rewards.py:499-500) -- the exact hook this port needs, already used by black_star, driftwood, lava_rock, paels_wing and wongos_mystery_ticket. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes.py aubergine-gold): the relic is Common in the transcribed shared grab bag, and a MONSTER reward screen pays rewards.gold=19 / run.gold delta=19 BOTH with and without it, where C# pays 15 more. IMPLEMENTATION NOTE for whoever fixes it: rewards.py grants the gold at line 464/485, BEFORE the modify_combat_rewards loop at 499, so a fix that only mutates rewards.gold would display the 15 without banking it -- it must call run.gain_gold as well, the way the relic-appending hooks grant their own relics.

AfterModifyingRewards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status = RelicStatus.* are presentation only (the relic card's glow and its greyed/active state in the relic bar); the sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N1: the `player != base.Owner` and `room == null` early bails (AmethystAubergine.cs:27-34)
guards.rationale: The owner check is the multiplayer per-player reward filter; the sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one player) so it has nobody else's rewards to modify. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract. The null-room bail is defensive and has no sim counterpart to diverge from.

guards.what: N2: the final-act-boss exclusion (`CurrentActIndex >= Acts.Count - 1`, AmethystAubergine.cs:39-42)
guards.issue: Part of the same unported TryModifyRewards body, recorded separately because a fix that adds the gold but forgets this clause would pay 15 extra on the run's last boss where the game pays nothing. Carries TryModifyRewards' LIVE label: the sim reaches final-act boss rooms (the conformance seeds run to the act-2 boss today) and models CurrentActIndex.

guards.what: N3: GoldVar(15) (AmethystAubergine.cs:18) -- the numeric constant, checked against the non-ascension branch
guards.rationale: A bare GoldVar(15) with no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension anywhere in the file, so 15 is the pinned value. The sim has no constant to compare because it has no implementation; recorded so the number is on file for the fix.
